//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Simple Menu -> Config

Enable Simple Menu.//: Whether Simple Menu is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

setCustomWindowTitle.//: Whether a custom window title should be set. Uses the value set in 'customWindowTitle'.

customWindowTitle.//: The custom window title that's used when 'setCustomWindowTitle' is enabled.

setCustomWindowIcon.//: If a custom window icon should be set. Two files are needed. Both in PNG format. One a 16 pixel square called 'icon_16x16.png', and one a 32 pixel square called 'icon_32x32.png'. Located in './config/serilum/simplemenu/icon'.

replaceMainMenuLogo.//: If a custom main menu logo should be rendered. This will replace the 'Minecraft' text. A 'logo.png' file is needed. Located in './config/serilum/simplemenu/logo'. By default the image dimensions are 1024x256. To remove it completely, use an empty .png file.

replaceMainMenuEditionLogo.//: If a custom main menu 'edition' logo should be rendered. This will replace the 'Java Edition' text. An 'edition.png' file is needed. Located in './config/serilum/simplemenu/logo'. By default the image dimensions are 512x64. To remove it completely, use an empty .png file.

setCustomBackground.//: If a custom background should be rendered. A 'background.png' file is needed. Located in './config/serilum/simplemenu/background/'.

hideMinecraftRealmsButton.//: If the Minecraft Realms button should be hidden from the main menu. Enabled by default, since modded Minecraft is incompatible with it.

expandModsButton.//: Whether the Mods button's width should be expanded to match the singleplayer button width. Can be useful with 'hideMinecraftRealmsButton' disabled. Only applicable for Forge and NeoForge.

enableServerPromoButton.//: Whether the Minecraft Realms button should be replaced by a serverhosting promo button.

serverPromoButtonTextDefault.//: The default server promo button text.

serverPromoButtonTextOnHover.//: The server promo button text shown when hovering it.

serverPromoButtonClickURL.//: The URL that's being navigated to when clicking the server promo button.

hideSplashText.//: Whether the splash text should be hidden on the main menu.

removeExperimentalModLoaderText.//: Whether experimental/beta mod loader text should be removed from the main menu.

removeTextBottomLeft.//: Whether the text in the bottom left should be removed from the main menu.
